pk.context: 75 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Its effect depends on CYP2C19 converting it to an active metabolite, and its boxed warning covers two loss-of-function alleles.

clues.text: Absorption is at least 50%, judged by urinary excretion of metabolites. About half of a dose is excreted in urine and 46% in feces over 5 days; most circulating metabolites are an inactive acid.
A bisulfate salt; the parent moiety has a molecular weight of 321.8. It is practically insoluble in water at neutral pH but freely soluble at pH 1.
Approved under NDA 020839 as 75 mg and 300 mg tablets, taken daily.
Boxed warning for diminished effect with two loss-of-function CYP2C19 alleles. Contraindicated with active bleeding and hypersensitivity; intracranial hemorrhage and fatal bleeding are key.
Acute coronary syndrome, including NSTEMI and STEMI, and recent MI, recent stroke or established peripheral arterial disease, to reduce the rate of MI and stroke.
Its CYP2C19-formed thiol metabolite irreversibly binds P2Y12 ADP receptors on platelets, blocking aggregation for the lifespan of the platelet.
The generic name begins with C and has eleven letters.
